intro b hb
have hp := h_T004.2 b hb

  simp [Reduction.Jcoord, hb]

    Reduction.Jcoord p M (act y) v0 j.val ≤ Reduction.Jcoord p M (act y) v0 i.val := by
  intro c hc

refine ⟨heq, ?_⟩
intro z hz i
rw [← heq i]
apply (hmem i _).2
have hh := (hp i i).2.2.1 z hz
